BiblicalUsage: When Pharaoh saw that there was respite, he hardened his heart, and Jeremiah prays, hide not Thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.
TheologicalSignificance: I am convinced that relief misused hardens the heart, and relief sought in prayer softens it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
